title: Robotic Arm Workshop
blurb: Serial-controlled servo robotics. Drive the arm by hand with the keyboard, then write your own routines and run them on the hardware.
quickStart:
cd "Robotic Arm"
pip install pyserial keyboard
python teleop_keyboard.py
quickStartNote: Enter your COM number when prompted (3 for COM3). WASD and arrow keys drive the arm; press t to run the latest run_program.py.

title: Arduino Workshop
blurb: Two beginner projects. An LED starter sketch with step-by-step TODOs driven over the Serial Monitor, plus a buzzer build you can extend with buttons and other outputs.
